assumptions_and_limits: The existing RoundWorld IDs are valid opaque list values because these four bodies only store or compare the original pointer-sized tokens; they never dereference them. Scoring resolves the stored IDs to real Round state.

The partial storage contains only the +764h section pointer and +7DCh vector; unrelated bytes are padding, never consumed as fabricated game fields. It is not a complete MCommandBuilding or a drop-in binary ABI.
Each list belongs to its actual building handle for the RoundWorld lifetime, and frees its buffer and Win32 section on teardown.
Build, fixture and compiled reachability evidence do not establish live gameplay behavior; the game was not run.
